info.name: CampusFix API
info.description: CampusFix REST API. Run "npm run seed" in backend first, then run the three Login requests under Authentication. Tokens and ids are stored in collection variables automatically. Run the Student > Create complaint request before the Admin and Staff folders.

request.description: Postman keeps the cf_refresh cookie from the last login. Returns a new access token and rotates the refresh cookie.
